lines.en:
In all my life, I've never seen this place...
Back to where it all began.  Protagonist... I think you would know just what to do...  All I've ever done is fight... it is all I know.
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: \c[1]Diana is determined to keep the fight going, until the army is again made whole.  Choose who will go with her.
lines.zh: \c[1]戴安娜决心继续战斗，直到全军再次齐聚。 选择跟从她的人马。
